page.layout: One column of summary lines (Summarium) on the right printed page, each line with a marginal number at its left. Catchword at the lower right. A strip at the far left is the edge of the neighbouring page and is left out.

main_text.head: Præleċtionis Secundæ Summa-rium.

l.i: Ad bonitatem Actus non sufficere bonam Intentionem;
Probatur Primò, ex ipsis Apostoli Verbis.
——Tertiò, à conditionibus ad bonitatem actus requisitis
——Quintò, à Dei vindictâ, punientis Legis suæ (etsi bonâ intentione factam) trans-gressionem.

main_text.l: Corollar. Primum. Zelo Gloriæ Dei ne ad illicita perpetranda feramur, cavendum.&c.
Secundum. Non esse admittendum aliquod peccatum nostrum, ut impediatur majus alienum.&c.

l.i: Liceatne saltem alteri suadere minus pecca-tum, ut majus impediatur.

main_text.l: Tertium. Non esse malo malum pellendum.&c.

page.notes: The line numbers in the left margin are partly cut off by the binding and are not legible, so only "&c." is recorded where it is visible. The large initial C of the first line is joined to the word as "Conscientiæ". The strip at the far left shows the edge of the adjacent page and is not transcribed.
